name: Michigan Tech Summer Youth Programs
org: Michigan Technological University, Summer Youth Programs
what_you_do: Take a week-long exploration course at Michigan Tech. Topics run from STEM and engineering to business, the arts and the humanities. You can live on campus or commute.
grades: Middle and high school (exact grades not stated)
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students from around the world. The cost page lists no grade rules.
pay_detail: Exploration programs start at $1,175 live-in (tuition, fees, meals, room and board) or $700 commuter. A $150 non-refundable deposit is due at registration. Pathway program fees vary. Scholarships exist.
deadline_text: 2027 registration and program dates are not posted yet on the pages read. Balances are due in full by May 1 and most scholarships are reviewed on a rolling basis.
how_to_apply: Use the Sign Up Now link on the Summer Youth Programs page and pay the $150 deposit at registration. Pathway programs have nothing due at application. Contact syp@mtu.edu or 906-487-2219.
notes: Extra costs can include lab fees, a $20 weekly parking pass and charter bus service. Check the Course Catalog and Scholarships pages on the SYP site for current offerings.
